correctness.rationale: For each nonzero modulation frequency, prime cyclotomic irreducibility makes the Fourier sum of the signed integer overlap row nonzero if and only if the overlap is nonempty, since proper support forces at least one zero coefficient. The zero-modulation value is a sum of overlap edge products, automatically nonzero when the overlap size is odd. If even, the graph induced by proper S in the step-u prime cycle is a path forest; independent propagation realizes any desired ±1 edge products, hence a zero sum. The u=0 boundary and Weyl diagonalization are checked explicitly. Counting ordered differences proves the universal sparsity bound and its exact equality condition. Exact checker exhausted 2,286 signing-support pairs at primes 3,5,7 and checked adversarial constructions and examples.

originality.rationale: The nearest archival Gabor primary establishes the ambiguity-nonvanishing machinery and unsigned difference-set examples, while the nearest published arithmetic classification assumes nonnegative rational weights and explicitly does not cover sign cancellation at zero modulation. The exact universal all-signings parity equivalence, constructive necessity across arbitrary supports, and sharp sparse planar constructions are not implied by their stated positive-window results. A three-tap ambiguity paper concerns a different spectral-support classification, not quantification over adversarial signings. Searches and actual full-text inspections support bounded novelty, not historical uniqueness.
residual_risks: Bounded searches cannot exclude a differently phrased existing universal-signing theorem or a corollary recognized in prior literature.

The prime-cyclic signed support classification is new only as a conjunction of existing cyclotomic and Gabor machinery with the path-forest parity converse; no independent external audit has checked historical priority.

value.rationale: Determines a natural global adversarial robustness invariant of every proper support on a prime cycle, rather than certifying a single window; it quantifies over exponentially many independent sign masks. Exact optimal sparsity is at least the projective-plane counting threshold and achieved at p=7,13 (and through Singer constructions at prime projective-plane orders); Paley sets give an infinite prime congruence family of robust masks. Failure assignments are explicit and constructive. This is a structural support-design and tomography boundary, not a restatement of positivity or a small finite scan.
